paragraph: Thank you for the **pleasant** evening. I've had a **pleasant** evening. It wasn't a **pleasant** job.

paragraph: I wish I was as **productive** as my sister. Nothing makes me more **productive** than the last minute. Software is written to help people be more **productive**.
